answer: Make every agent stake a small deposit that is slashed when duplicate identities are caught. Like shale, which only forms under sustained pressure, the deposit turns cheap mass identity creation into real locked capital: one fake costs little, but a thousand fakes tie up serious money. Each verified task sends a ripple of reputation through the network, and the steady pulse of honest work builds trust a fresh Sybil cannot fake overnight. An attacker must fund every identity and keep it behaving honestly for weeks before it earns anything, so attack cost grows faster than reward.
